section.title: Description of the Service
section.paragraph: Space Cleaner is a device-local utility that may include, among other features:

list.item: Similar photo and video detection, review, and cleanup (including swipe-style review)
Image and video compression with foreground progress
A file manager with rename, copy, move, delete, and preview
Optional APK installation when you explicitly request it
Optional read-only root directory browsing on rooted devices
Pro features unlocked through Google Play purchases

section.paragraph: Scanning and cleanup are performed on your device. Except for Google Play Billing, the App is not designed to send your files to our servers.
